name: LRU Cache Management for Voxel Bricks
definition: A cache management strategy for voxel bricks that prioritizes reusing data not used for the longest time to optimize memory reuse while keeping useful data.
summary: LRU Cache Management for Voxel Bricks is a memory strategy for out-of-core volume rendering that retains recently accessed bricks, distinguishing itself by managing cache state on the CPU to bypass shader write limitations.
